taxonomy.note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO and FNA. Historical names now synonymized here include Callirhoe digitata var. stipulata.

evidence: Travis County — UT Plant Resources Center's Malvaceae herbarium index includes three Callirhoe pedata specimens.
Williamson County — UT Plant Resources Center lists a field-based county treatment for Callirhoe pedata.
Kerr County — the Kerr Wildlife Management Area vascular flora includes Callirhoe pedata.
Burnet County — Texas Wildbuds documents multiple field occurrences along FM 1174 north of Bertram.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Historical 'Callirhoe digitata' Texas records require taxonomic reinterpretation; only records consistent with modern C. pedata are counted.

morphology.look_here_first: Start at the stipules and flower arrangement. Palmleaf poppymallow is a perennial with persistent linear-lanceolate stipules, usually 3–5 deeply divided fingerlike leaf lobes, NO involucel, and flowers arranged in a raceme. The calyx forms a pointed bud.
diagnostic_traits: perennial, 15–90 cm, erect to weakly erect
stems essentially glabrous/glaucous or sparsely hairy
leaves cordate/suborbiculate/ovate in outline, crenate or 3–5-lobed
lobes often narrow/fingerlike and may be further divided
calyx lobes valvate in bud and pointed
petals reddish purple typically without a white basal spot
mericarps indehiscent; collars absent or weak

confusers.separator: True C. digitata is not a Texas species in current FNA; it has caducous stipules, 5–10 narrow leaf lobes and a paniculate inflorescence. Older Texas C. digitata var. stipulata belongs here in C. pedata.
Both lack an involucel, but C. leiocarpa is annual/biennial with strongly auriculate stipules and dehiscent mericarps. C. pedata is perennial with persistent narrow stipules and indehiscent fruits.
Winecup is low/trailing and has three involucellar bractlets; C. pedata is erect/ascending and lacks an involucel.

diagnostic_roles: flower underside showing absence of involucel

installation_guardrail: Do not install until explicit approval.
